'''Tomaas Azzameen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the brother of [[Antan Azzameen]], the father of [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]], [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]], [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]], and [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]], and the head of the [[Azzameen family]]. Tomaas was also the head of [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]], the family's business.

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Tomaas Azzameen was a businessman and the head of the [[Azzameen family]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]]. Azzameen was the business partner of his friend, [[Dunari]], before the two went their separate ways and Azzameen co-founded the shipping company [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]] with his brother, [[Antan Azzameen]]. While serving as head of the company,<ref name="LA" /> Azzameen lived aboard [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Station]]<ref name="XWA" /> in a [[Azzameen Station system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Garis sector/Legends|Garis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> with his [[Reproduction/Legends|children]], [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]], [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]], [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]] and [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]], who joined him in the family business upon coming of age. Despite the difficulties of running a business during a period of [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|civil war]] and the schemes of corrupt [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officials,<ref name="XWA" /> Twins Suns became successful under Azzameen's leadership. However, the company's success led to a feud with [[K'Armyn Viraxo]], the patriarch of the [[Viraxo]] family and head of [[Viraxo Industries]], the dominant shipping company in that region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LA" />

Azzameen was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in its fight against the Galactic Empire. Although he stopped short of joining the Alliance, Azzameen was determined to help them however he could and was concerned that the feud with the Viraxo would attract unwanted attention from the Empire. This brought him into conflict with Antan, who felt that the family could not afford to become involved with the Rebellion and argued that they needed to focus on the threat posed by the Viraxo. Despite his brother's reservations, however, Azzameen attempted to secure a truce with the Viraxo and entered into negotiations with the Alliance to act as a middleman in a deal to acquire a supply of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="XWA" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Azzameen and Galin took Azzameen's personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]], the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'', to the Alliance's [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the ice-[[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The pair were still on the planet when it was attacked<ref name="XWA" /> by an [[Death Squadron/Legends|Imperial fleet]] under the command of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

[[File:Tomaas_Galin_Otana_XWA.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tomaas and Galin onboard the ''Otana'']]
As the Rebels prepared to evacuate the base,<ref name="ESB" /> the Azzameens made their own attempt to leave in the ''Otana'', escorted by two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] from [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]]. The ''Otana''{{'s}} escape vector was blocked by two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], but the Rebels used Echo Base's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] to temporarily disable one of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], allowing the ''Otana'' to pass. The X-wing escorts cleared a path through a group of Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], but the ''Otana'' was struck by debris from one of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] before jumping to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. With the ''Otana''{{'s}} primary [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]] tank damaged, Azzameen decided to take the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to Antan on the family's [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|Twin Sun Station]] for repairs. Arriving in the [[Roccus system]], Azzameen contacted his brother to request emergency repairs. Antan, however, was concerned that the Empire would trace the ''Otana'' back to the Azzameens, despite Tomaas's precautions, and refused to allow the ship to dock. As a result, the ''Otana'' was forced to head back to Azzameen Station for repairs.<ref name="XWA" />

Soon after returning from Hoth, Azzameen gave his youngest son, Ace, his first assignment for Twin Suns, sending him and Aeron to deliver a cargo to [[Harlequin Station]] and pick up some [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]] and [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]] for the ''Otana''. While at Harlequin Station, the two young Azzameens helped to fend off an attempted attack by Viraxo ships. Shortly after this, Azzameen learned that some records from the company's cargo storage areas had gone missing. Before he and Galin set out on the first of a series of short trips to<ref name="XWA" /> the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|170|Smuggler's Run}}</ref> [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]], Azzameen gave Aeron permission to work on a new security code system for the storage area records, which led her and Ace to discover that the Viraxo were attempting to plant contraband in one of the Twin Suns facilities to cause trouble for the Azzameens with the Empire. Antan hatched a plan to have Emon, Aeron and Ace plant the contraband at a [[Viraxo 54|Viraxo facility]] before an Imperial inspection. However, all did not go as planned; although Azzameen's children escaped unharmed, they were forced to scupper one of the family's [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]], the ''[[Selu]]''. Upon his return to Azzameen Station, Azzameen was angry to learn that Antan had placed his children at risk on a dangerous and illegal errand.<ref name="XWA" />

During Azzameen's trips to Smuggler's Run, he arranged to rendezvous with a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] group to procure a supply of bacta for the Alliance. Galin accompanied Azzameen to the rendezvous point aboard the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Vasudra]]'' and Azzameen asked his other children to provide an escort, with Aeron in the ''Otana'', Ace in the YT-1300 light freighter ''[[Sabra]]'' and Emon in the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]] ''[[Andrasta]]''. The Azzameens traveled to [[Saruwen Station]], from where the [[SCT Scout craft|SCT Scout Craft]] ''[[Ravenno]]'' led them to the rendezvous with the [[Xiytiar-class heavy transport/Legends|''Xiytiar''-class transport]] [[End Run (Xiytiar-class)|''End Run'']]. After the ''Vasudra'' docked with the ''End Run'' to begin the bacta transfer, the smugglers claimed that they were having trouble with their pumps and dispatched [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] in [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suits]] to fix the problem. However, instead of fixing the ''End Run''{{'s}} pumps, the "technicians" attempted to disable the ''Vasudra''{{'s}} [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and the Azzameens were ambushed by several smuggler vessels. As Azzameen and Galin fought off borders on the ''Vasudra'', Aeron, Ace and Emon destroyed the other smuggler vessels. When the ''End Run''{{'s}} crew realized the ambush had failed, they agreed to complete the bacta transfer in exchange for Azzameen's assurances that he would allow them to leave.<ref name="XWA" />

Azzameen arranged to deliver the bacta to the Alliance and was instructed to meet with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Olin Garn]]&mdash;a family friend and former Twin Suns employee&mdash;near [[Brint-wo Colony]]. Azzameen and Galin again traveled aboard the ''Vasudra'', accompanied by Emon in the ''Andrasta'' and Ace in the ''Otana''. Garn led the Azzameens to the Rebel [[XQ2 Platform]] [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|''Hospital'']], where many casualties from the Battle of Hoth were receiving treatment. The ''Vasudra'' docked with Hospital and began transferring the bacta, but the operation was [[Battle of Hospital|interrupted]] by the arrival of Imperial forces led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garreth Holtz/Legends|Garreth Holtz]] aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Corrupter (Imperial-class)|''Corrupter'']]. Suspicious that the Azzameens were working with Holtz, the Rebels ordered Azzameen to surrender command of the ''Vasudra''. Azzameen complied and instructed his sons to join the Rebel starfighter screen and cover the evacuation of ''Hospital''. With help from Emon and Ace, most of the Rebel ships safely jumped to hyperspace, but the ''Vasudra'' was unable to escape and both Azzameen and Galin were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="XWA" />

===Legacy===
Tomaas' contact with the Rebellion would prove costly for the Azzameens as the Imperials became aware of their activities following the ambush on the ''Hospital'', and ordered the seizure of all Azzameen family assets. Twin Suns Services suffered heavily as the majority of its facilities were seized, but the Azzameen children (and eventually Antan) fled from Imperial custody.

Tomaas' ideals lived on in his children Ace, Aeron, and Emon, who joined the Rebellion in their cause to defeat the Empire. Ace Azzameen in particular would rise to become one of the greatest pilots in the Rebel Alliance.

Some time later, Antan claimed to his family that Tomaas was alive in [[Kessel Station]] along with Galin. However, this was only a plot to trap the kids and surrender them to the Empire, in revenge for their Rebel activities. This plot failed however, as the Azzameens survived the ambush and presumably forced Antan on the run. Having survived this ruse, the Azzameens assumed their father and brother to be dead for sure.
